data.content_ref: inline:The problem 061ddfcce3bb abstracts the 'variance-reduction' mechanism of SRC_004 into a formal test for 'blind compliance', suggesting that the elimination of the expert's blind spot is only 'genuine' if the panel can also identify systemic errors in the checklist itself. This relation is refuted if the panel's reliance on the checklist prevents them from ever detecting the systemic errors the expert would have overridden.
